_howto: MERCH — two featured items shown on the home page between The Links and
Latest. Once the Shopify store at freewillridez.store is live,
scripts/refresh-merch.mjs (hourly workflow) pulls the store's Featured
items below, downloading product images to src/merch/<handle>.webp.
Until then these two hand-seeded drops are shown. To feature products:
in Shopify admin, add them to the 'Home page' (frontpage) collection —
the top two appear here automatically within the hour.
Fields: id, title, url, image, and optional price (string, e.g. '45.00').
_auto: Auto-refreshed hourly by scripts/refresh-merch.mjs from the store’s Featured (frontpage) collection. Edit the collection in Shopify admin, not this file.
